dogecoin.text: Now Musk is in the government. How ethical is the presence of a person who used speculative methods with Dogecoin, an unnecessary technology, to exploit the greed of others? Does this raise questions about impunity, and how ethically right is this? Is it example to follow now ?

@elonmusk @realDonaldTrump @DOGE @elonmusk Who really needs DOGE? What problem does Dogecoin solve that real tech can't? In times of stagflation, shouldn't we focus on advancing impactful technologies that address real economic challenges instead of promoting something centered on your interests?
